exposure: Sonographic scoring system for adherent placenta (stages 0-3)
sonographic scoring system for adherent placenta
cohort: 109 women suspected of having morbidly adherent placenta
finding: The sonographic scoring system was significantly associated with the need for blood transfusions, clinical diagnosis of adherent placenta, and duration of postoperative hospitalization.
mod_finding: A history of cesarean delivery was significantly associated with hysterectomy, treatment with any blood products, and the duration of postoperative hospitalization in cases of suspected morbidly adherent placenta.
